turns.question: How many customers placed more than three orders between 17 August and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for customers with more than three orders, so I cannot give that count. The closest metrics are Active customers (customers_distinct, distinct customers with at least one non-cancelled order), Orders (orders_total, all orders placed including cancelled) and Repeat customers (repeat_customers, customers with two or more orders in all). No query was run, so there is no freshness statement to report.
